messages:
Maria H: Heads-up — forecasting a sustained shift in token mix from SearchFlow: streaming sessions with longer contexts. Our sim shows ~2.8–3.2x tokens/request starting Mon. Need a capacity + prewarm plan and cost hedge.
Rohan S: Quick baseline numbers? avg tokens now vs expected?
Maria H: Baseline avg ~400 tokens, peak QPS ~320 in us-west-2. New streaming mix -> avg ~1.2k tokens and connections stay open, so effective throughput per GPU drops ~25–30%.
Jules: Ran a short simulation on master branch kernel tweaks — if KV cache hit is ~60% we still see GPU hours up ~18–22% unless we increase batching or route traffic.
Tanvi K: Region note: us-west-2 reserved capacity is at ~88% during peak. We can't shove extra GA traffic there without using burst pool or routing to other regions.
Leo: Suggestion: pre-bake a small warm pool sized for streaming (sticky sockets) — estimate +10% steady cost, but reduces cold-start latency by ~40% and lowers tail latency.
infra-bot: [node-monitor] Warning: node-lease expiry bumped in us-west-2a, 2 nodes marked for graceful eviction due to disk pressure.
Rohan S: Proposed immediate actions: 1) prewarm +10% warm pool for streaming nodes; 2) policy: route 30% of streaming traffic to us-east-1 dedicated; 3) enable aggressive KV prefetch (0.5s window) and increase batch window by 30ms.
Maria H: + add fallback model: quantized-8b variant for the longest contexts to cap GPU-hours. Need a rollout/canary plan and smoke tests before full policy.
Jules: I pushed a canary config to staging: /infra/canaries/epochal-tokenmix. Test command I used:
```
kubectl -n inference exec -it sim-client -- ./run_sim.sh --qps 100 --mean_tokens 1200 --streaming
```
Tanvi K: Quick cost calc from crude model: current monthly GPU hours ~72,000. New mix +18% -> ~85k hrs. At present spot/reserved blend that's roughly +$32k/mo. With 30% routing to cheaper region and prewarm efficiency, net incremental ~+$12k/mo.
Leo: Ops checklist: update autoscaler minReplicas for inference pool, bump warm-pool rotation TTL, tweak node-lease to 90s to prevent eviction during long-lived streams, and add an alert for prewarm exhaustion.
Maria H: I'll open JIRA (INFRA-7421) with the tasks and owners. @Rohan S @Jules please own execution and post perf graphs. We'll reconvene in 6 hours after the staging canary run.
Rohan S: 👍 starting canary in ~10m. Will post latency/p99 and GPU util.
Jules: on it — posting initial perf heatmaps in ~30m :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Tanvi K: If we see sustained higher-than-expected tokenmix, we should trigger the fallback quantized variant automatically (canary -> 50% -> 100%) to protect SLOs.
Maria H: Agreed. Add rollout automation in the canary job. Thanks team.
